card.title: Secrets Have Value
card.instruction: Price every fact, introduction, warning, and confession as something that must be traded for equal value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll name the coworker who reported your lateness if you name whoever reported mine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll trade departments. Names cost names.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Payroll. But I can introduce you to my source.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Marketing. And I'll arrange coffee with mine. Same access, same price.

mechanism: A prices information by matching both its specificity and the access being traded.
confusable: Unlike exchanging gossip casually, A must insist each new level receives equivalent value.
comparison: Workplace sources trade departments and introductions; the family alternative prices confessions by expected punishment.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
